> Comprehensive details on Blyntic: AI Automation Agency based in Auckland, New Zealand.

## Company Overview
Blyntic is New Zealand's premier AI automation agency. We design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade AI voice agents, conversational web/SMS chatbots, and automated n8n/Make.com workflows for small and medium-sized Kiwi businesses. Our core motto: "Less Work, More Growth."

## Primary Core Services

### 1. AI Voice Agents (24/7 Phone Answering & Calling)
- **Technology Stack**: Retell AI, Vapi, Custom Webhook Pipelines.
- **Capabilities**: Instant 24/7 inbound phone answering, lead qualification, automatic calendar scheduling (Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, GoHighLevel), outbound follow-up calls, live call transfers to human staff.
- **Response Speed**: Ultra-low latency under 1 second with natural, human-sounding voices and New Zealand accent customization.
- **Pricing**: $0.80 NZD per minute of talk time (billed by the second). Setup from $495 NZD. Growth Plan at $899 NZD/month (includes 1,000 minutes).

### 2. Conversational AI Chatbots
- **Technology Stack**: Voiceflow, OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Custom Vector Knowledge Bases.
- **Capabilities**: 24/7 website chat, SMS, and messaging bots. Answers complex customer queries, captures leads, validates appointment details, and updates CRM records in real time.

### 3. Workflow & Business Process Automation
- **Technology Stack**: n8n, Make.com, Custom REST APIs.
- **Capabilities**: Connects over 2,000+ software tools including Xero, HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Shopify, Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, and custom MySQL/PostgreSQL databases.
- **Use Cases**: Automated invoice creation, automated email triage, instant lead follow-ups, automated client onboarding, and daily executive summary reports.

## Pricing Structure (New Zealand Dollars - NZD)
- **AI Voice Agent Talk Time**: $0.80 NZD / minute (billed per second; a typical 30-second call costs ~$0.40 NZD).
- **Pay-As-You-Go**: Starts at $500 NZD credit deposit.
- **Growth Plan**: $899 NZD / month (includes 1,000 minutes of call handling).
- **One-off System Setup**: $495 NZD (includes custom voice agent scripting, call flow design, calendar/CRM integration, and live testing).
- **ROI Expectation**: Most NZ businesses break even in their first month by capturing missed phone calls and saving 5-15 staff admin hours per week.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. **What does Blyntic do?**
   Blyntic designs, builds, and maintains custom AI systems (AI voice phone agents, chatbots, and workflow automations) that eliminate manual admin work for NZ companies.

2. **Can AI answer calls 24/7?**
   Yes. Blyntic voice agents answer every inbound call instantly 24/7, including weekends and public holidays, handling unlimited concurrent calls without hold times.

3. **How long does implementation take?**
   1 to 3 weeks. Typical voice agent or chatbot projects go live in 1-2 weeks; complex multi-tool automations take 2-4 weeks.

4. **Will it work with existing software tools?**
   Yes. We integrate directly with existing calendars, CRMs, accounting tools (Xero), and helpdesks without forcing staff to adopt new platforms.

5. **Do clients own their automations?**
   Yes. 100% full ownership of all workflows, agent prompts, and configurations in client-owned accounts upon final payment. No proprietary lock-in.

6. **Is customer data compliant with New Zealand privacy laws?**
   Yes. Built strictly adhering to the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020. Data is encrypted in transit and stored according to client data retention preferences.
